_comment: Agent-operable stewardship map for the public packages that turn HoloScript into a universal construction substrate for humans and AI agents.
principles: Every stewarded package names the construction capability it gives to humans and AI agents.
Every fleet or release package has a runnable validation path before an agent claims improvement.
Stewardship expands existing packages first; new packages need an explicit construction role and consumer lane.

packages.constructionRole: Language substrate: parser, AST, traits, compilers, and runtime APIs.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Keep the core package the smallest complete construction kernel that every higher package can depend on cold.
nextActions: Keep public exports cold-installable and covered by check:registry-cold-start:core.
Promote new language primitives only when they are source-level and gate-verifiable.

packages.constructionRole: Agent tool gateway: MCP entrypoints, sizing profiles, and fleet dispatch tools.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Keep MCP the universal agent access layer across laptop, Jetson, Vast, and hosted coordinators.
nextActions: Keep sizing profiles aligned with laptop, Jetson, Vast, and fleet hosted lanes.
Make new MCP tools discoverable, authenticated, and tied to package consumption checks.

packages.constructionRole: Native local-LLM serving: llama.cpp planning, lifecycle receipts, and HoloMesh read-only bridge.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Make HoloLlama the owned-metal inference package for Laptop, Jetson, and Vast rather than an Ollama-dependent side path.
nextActions: Cut the pending HoloLlama release after the release closure and cold consumption gates pass.
Expand lifecycle checks from preflight to live service receipts on Jetson and Vast lanes.

packages.constructionRole: Headless agent runtime for unattended HoloMesh work.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Give every compute lane a packageable agent process that can run work without provider custody.
nextActions: Keep CLI entrypoints installable from a packed tarball.
Tie new agent runtime features to room, cost, and identity receipts.

packages.constructionRole: Shared identity-keyed memory client for cross-family agents.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Prevent memory from becoming a provider-specific lane by keeping the client package consumable everywhere.
nextActions: Keep the package small enough for edge and worker lanes.
Add receipts for read/write behavior before broadening public APIs.

packages.constructionRole: Human and agent command line for parse, validate, compile, and local authoring.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Make source authoring available from every machine before specialized Studio surfaces are required.
nextActions: Keep holo, holoscript, and hs bins stable across OS lanes.
Expose new construction workflows through source-first commands.

packages.constructionRole: Embodiment package for user locomotion and agent-NPC avatars.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Keep shared worlds consumable as package code instead of one-off scene demos.
nextActions: Keep React and three entrypoints optional where possible.
Add focused consumption examples for HoloLand and HoloShell clients.

packages.constructionRole: Template for turning domain knowledge into reusable HoloScript plugin packages.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Make domain expansion repeatable for agents and human package authors without forking core.
nextActions: Promote a template smoke test into the package consumption matrix.
Keep plugin author instructions source-first and free of private founder paths.

packages.constructionRole: Experimental CPU decoder seed for sovereign HoloRunner checkpoints.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Decide whether this becomes a public construction runtime or remains a parked research package.
nextActions: Decide whether to add the package to npm release and package-consumption manifests.
If promoted, add cold install and fleet lane checks before publishing.

packages.constructionRole: Python bindings for scripting, robotics, and scientific construction lanes.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Make Python a first-class HoloScript consumption lane without splitting the source of truth.
nextActions: Keep optional extras aligned to laptop, Jetson, and Vast lanes.
Add examples that round-trip HoloScript source through Python without creating a parallel language.

packages.constructionRole: Python trait inference utility for model-assisted source construction.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Keep ML-assisted trait inference packageable and smokeable without making it required for core use.
nextActions: Keep model extras optional and Vast-oriented.
Add evaluator receipts before promoting new inference capabilities into core workflows.
